title: Intermediate Layer-Assisted Trap Density Reduction in Low-Power Optoelectronic Memristors for Multifunctional Systems
authors: Min Jong Lee, Tae Hyuk Kim, Sang Heon Lee, Seunghyun Oh, Muhammad Asghar Khan, Gyeong Min Lee, Young Kyun Choi, Soyeon Lee, Hyungju Ahn, Soong Ju Oh, Jiwoong Yang, and Jae Won Shim*
imageAlt: Editorial artwork of an illuminated optoelectronic memristor interface with an intermediate trap-control layer; not experimental imagery
featuredQuestion: Can interface trap control reduce the voltage and power required for optoelectronic switching?
featuredContribution: An ALD TiO₂ intermediate layer limits interfacial trapping and enables low-voltage switching in optoelectronic memristors, linking interface design to device function.
featuredMetrics: 15× lower interfacial trap density · +0.24 V SET · ≈0.7 μW switching power
